description: Cut a finished video node to [startSeconds, endSeconds] on the server. Creates a "Clip" (video-result) node wired from the source, as the in-app Clip tool does, and queues the existing FFmpeg film worker, which cuts the stored clip (re-encoded, frame accurate) and attaches the MP4 to that node. The range must be at least 0.2 s and inside the clip; the worker re-checks it against the probed duration. The source must be a finished clip in this project's storage. Free: no credits are spent. Revision checked and idempotent. Returns immediately; poll playground_run_delivery with the returned runId (every ≥30 s) until verified, or read the Clip node's generated URL with playground_node_get.

endSeconds.description: End of the retained clip in seconds; must be later than startSeconds.

expectedRevision.description: Current canvas revision from canvas_read; on revision_conflict, read again and rebuild the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this request; reuse only when retrying the identical request after a lost response. Use a new key after quoting or changing inputs.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

startSeconds.description: Start of the retained clip in seconds from the source video’s beginning.

title.description: Human-readable label to display for this item in Playground.

videoNodeId.description: Existing canvas video node ID containing the source video.

name: playground_video_trim
